crossRefs.note: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and…
I will strengthen them in Yahweh; and they will walk up and down in his name,” says Yahweh.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish…
though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your…
Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

translations.web: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
translations.bsb: The way of the LORD is a refuge to the upright, but destruction awaits those who do evil.
translations.kjv: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
translations.asv: The way of Jehovah is a stronghold to the upright; But it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
